skills_loaded.description: Additional task-specific skills the Architect actually loaded/read in this turn. Do not report the host-loaded mandatory Architect baseline merely because it was injected.

items.description: Canonical skill directory identifier from the pre-dispatch canonical skill catalog only (for example, "dual-agents"). A path to SKILL.md is never valid; invalid examples include "C:\CodexGlobal\skills\dual-agents\SKILL.md", "skills/dual-agents/SKILL.md", and "dual-agents/SKILL.md".
